description: Core gym loop: session engine + Active Workout Mode + timers + PR engine/celebration + exerciseHistory rollups + dynamic dashboard/DaySelector (design C.16 steps 7-9). This is the heart of the app - the in-gym PLAN->TRAIN->LOG flow, offline-first. Depends on FEAT-002 (auth/profile/seed) and FEAT-001 (types/libs/firebase/rules).
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT FIRST. Implement sessionStore, exerciseStore, and timerStore (src/store/*). timerStore uses persist with absolute anchors (workoutStartedAtMs, pausedAccumMs, rest.endsAtMs); elapsed is recomputed as now-startedAt-pausedAccum, a rAF/interval only drives the visible tick (background-safe per C.5/C.8a). Session states NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/ABANDONED with start/pause/resume/finish/abandon.

Build hooks src/hooks/useWorkoutTimer.ts and src/hooks/useRestTimer.ts (smart-rest: base=prescription.restSeconds preset-fallback 90s, +30s on RPE>=9 / RIR<=0, warmup cap 45s, disablable via smartRestEnabled; computes only the endsAtMs anchor) and the IntervalTimer HIIT state machine (IDLE->WORK(r)->REST(r)->...->DONE, absolute endsAtMs anchoring, auto-advance, pause/resume/skip, background-safe).

Build the Active Workout surface under app/(protected)/workout with components src/components/workout/{WorkoutHeader,WorkoutProgressBar,ExerciseCard,ExerciseDetails,SetTracker,SetRow,PreviousPerformance,ProgressionRecommendation,WorkoutTimer,RestTimer,IntervalTimer,SupersetGroup,StickyControls}.tsx: live elapsed timer, one exercise at a time, previous-performance panel from exerciseHistory, recommended target from progression lib, 2-3-tap set entry with autofill, adaptive RPE/RIR UI (RpeMode), next-exercise preview, sticky bottom controls, nav guard. Each live SetLog is a single-doc create/update through the SDK with uid + sessionCompleted:false stamped by sessionService/setService. A HIIT round logs one duration-based SetLog (durationSeconds, actualReps omitted, excluded from weight*reps volume).

Implement PR engine + celebration: progressService detects weight/rep/volume/e1RM PRs client-side from logged sets reading bounded cached exerciseHistory/{exerciseId}; PRs persisted at personalRecords/{sessionId}_{exerciseId}_{type} (deterministic ids); set isPr flags. src/components/pr/{PRBadge,PRCelebration}.tsx using framer-motion+gsap+canvas-confetti via next/dynamic ssr:false, honoring prefers-reduced-motion with optional vibration/sound. Implement exerciseHistory rollup upsert (bounded recentSessions ring + bests). progressStore.

Build the dynamic dashboard (app/(protected)/dashboard) + DaySelector: src/components/dashboard/{Dashboard,DaySelector,Greeting,TodayCard,StatTiles}.tsx. Greeting, today's workout auto-selected by day of week, set/exercise counts, estimated time, progress %, volume, streak, weekly volume, new PRs - all dynamic. Sunday rest-day variant. Swipeable DaySelector MON-SUN with per-day status, auto-selecting today. workoutStore. RSC shell + client data islands.
Run verification, fix failures, set FEAT status completed, record findings (offline/live gaps), commit locally (no push).
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build exit 0 with empty env.

A Vitest shows the workout timer resumes with the correct elapsed value after a simulated app close/reopen mid-session (AC-9), and the interval state machine advances WORK->REST->DONE across simulated time.
A Vitest shows a logged set that beats history produces the correct personalRecords doc(s) with deterministic ids and triggers the PR path (AC-7).
An RTL test shows DaySelector auto-selects today and renders the Sunday rest-day variant on Sundays (AC-13); SetTracker quick-log flow logs a set in a few interactions.
verification: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build  (exit 0, empty env)
pnpm vitest run src/store src/components/workout src/components/dashboard src/components/pr  (timer-resume, interval SM, PR detection, DaySelector today/Sunday, SetTracker flow)
Offline SetLog persistence against live/emulated Firestore and the live PR celebration render are recorded as 'needs verification during implementation'.
findings:
FEAT-003 complete. All gates green with EMPTY .env.local: pnpm lint (0 warnings), pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit), pnpm build (next build; 15 routes incl. /workout + dynamic /dashboard, next-pwa SW generated, nothing throws at import/build), and 85 Vitest tests pass (24 new; the prior 61 still green). No Firebase was mocked to fake success.

TIMERS (background-safe absolute anchoring, C.5/C.8a, AC-9). src/lib/intervalTimer.ts is a PURE HIIT state machine (IDLE->WORK(r)->REST(r)->...->DONE) with endsAtMs anchors: tick() auto-advances across every elapsed boundary (a long background gap resolves straight to DONE), pause stores remainingMs + clears anchor, resume re-derives endsAtMs=now+remainingMs, skip jumps one boundary. src/store/timerStore.ts (persist) owns three sub-timers: the workout clock (workoutStartedAtMs+pausedAccumMs+pausedAtMs+isPaused; elapsedSeconds recomputed as now-start-pausedAccum, frozen at pause instant), the rest countdown (rest.endsAtMs), and the interval machine. Hooks src/hooks/useWorkoutTimer.ts + useRestTimer.ts only drive the VISIBLE tick (setInterval) and read anchors — never the source of truth. useRestTimer exports computeRestSeconds (smart-rest wrapper over progression.smartRestSeconds: base=prescription.restSeconds, fallback 90s, +30s RPE>=9 / RIR<=0, warmup cap 45s, disablable) + REST_PRESETS 30/60/90/120/180.

SESSION ENGINE (src/store/sessionStore.ts, persist). ActiveSession state machine NOT_STARTED->IN_PROGRESS->COMPLETED|ABANDONED with start/setCurrentExercise/addSet/updateSet/completeSet/removeSet/flagPr/finish/abandon/clear + selectors (totalPlannedSets/completedSetCount/totalVolumeKg). The active session persists so a mid-workout reload RESUMES (Firestore stays the durable store for COMPLETED sessions; this is the optimistic copy). addSet autofills from the previous set (2-3-tap logging) and detects duration entries (intervalWork or targetRepMax===0) to seed durationSeconds + omit actualReps. exerciseSessionId = `${sessionId}__${exerciseId}__${order}` (sessionId=`sess_<uuid>` has no `__`, so split('__')[0] recovers it).

PR ENGINE (pure + client-side, C.7 Step 1, AC-7). src/lib/analytics/personalRecords.ts: detectPersonalRecords(history, sets) computes weight/reps/volume/e1rm PRs vs the bounded cached ExerciseHistory (warmup + duration-only sets excluded; no history => all PRs); buildPersonalRecords stamps DETERMINISTIC ids `${sessionId}_${exerciseId}_${type}` (personalRecordId). src/lib/analytics/exerciseHistory.ts: rollupExerciseHistory upserts the newest-first, sessionId-deduped, HISTORY_RING_SIZE(10)-bounded recentSessions ring + bests (picks the top-e1RM working set). SetTracker runs detection live on set-complete, flags isPr on the set, queues the celebration, and optimistically bumps the local best so a 2nd PR this session compares correctly.

CELEBRATION (C.6 dynamic island). src/components/pr/PRCelebration.tsx is a next/dynamic ssr:false wrapper around PRCelebrationView.tsx (framer-motion+gsap+canvas-confetti) so those browser-only libs never enter SSR/build (confirmed: /workout First Load JS stays ~288kB, the heavy libs are in a split chunk). Honors prefers-reduced-motion (skips confetti/gsap), optional vibration (navigator.vibrate) + sound (WebAudio), both best-effort. PRBadge.tsx is the inline marker.

ACTIVE WORKOUT SURFACE (app/(protected)/workout + src/components/workout/*). ActiveWorkout orchestrates: WorkoutHeader (name+WorkoutTimer), WorkoutProgressBar, RestTimer, one ExerciseCard at a time (ExerciseDetails + PreviousPerformance from exerciseHistory + ProgressionRecommendation from the pure lib + SetTracker/SetRow with adaptive RPE/RIR UI by RpeMode), StickyControls (prev/next with next-exercise preview + Finish), nav guard (beforeunload while IN_PROGRESS), PRCelebration. Interval entries (Battle Ropes) swap in IntervalTimer, logging ONE duration-based SetLog per completed WORK round (durationSeconds set, actualReps omitted, excluded from weight*reps volume). Each live set persist = single-doc create/update through sessionService.logSet stamping sessionCompleted:false; completion = sessionService.completeSession writeBatch gated on waitForPendingWrites(db) (C.7 HIGH-1 barrier, deterministic ids, idempotent) with PR/history computed BEFORE the batch. markSummaryApplied is the merge-update summaryApplied false->true toggle (C.7 Step 3). SetTracker exports activeSetToSetLog.

DASHBOARD (app/(protected)/dashboard + src/components/dashboard/*). RSC page -> Dashboard client island: Greeting, swipeable DaySelector MON-SUN (auto-selects today via workoutStore.selectToday on mount, per-day Rest/Train/Today status, AC-13), TodayCard (exercise+set counts, est. time, exercise preview; Sunday isRest variant), StatTiles (streak/weekly-volume/new-PRs/this-week derived by the pure deriveStats from sessionService.listRecentSessions; renders zeros + never throws under empty env). workoutStore ensures the seed plan so the dashboard renders a real split offline. Removed the old DashboardGreeting placeholder (superseded by Greeting).

NEW STORES: sessionStore, timerStore (persist), progressStore (history cache + pendingCelebration), workoutStore (plan + selectedDay + todayDayId). Added src/store/safeStorage.ts (safeJSONStorage) — SSR/test-safe zustand persist storage so persisted stores (timer/session/settings) don't crash where localStorage is absent (jsdom/SSR); wired into all three persist stores (settingsStore had the same latent bug, now fixed).

SERVICES/FIREBASE wiring: fleshed out sessionService (upsertSession/upsertExerciseSession/logSet/completeSession/markSummaryApplied/listRecentSessions/listExerciseSets) + progressService (getExerciseHistory/getExerciseHistories/listPersonalRecordsForExercise/listPersonalRecords) — all ServiceResult, client-null guarded (firebase/not-configured under empty env; services.test still green). Added converters: workoutPlanConverter, personalRecordConverter, exerciseHistoryConverter (RolledSet<->Timestamp, present()-spread). Added firestore.ts collection/doc helpers (sessions/exercises/sets/exerciseHistory/personalRecords/workoutPlans). Made queries.ts builders generic<T> so withConverter typing propagates through getDocs.

TESTS (24 new): intervalTimer.test.ts (SM transitions, background-skip-to-DONE, pause/resume no-drift, skip), timerStore.test.ts (AC-9 reopen-resume elapsed, paused-time exclusion, rest anchor, interval via store), analytics/personalRecords.test.ts (AC-7 weight+e1rm PR, reps-only, no-PR, warmup/duration ignored, first-session all-PRs, deterministic ids), analytics/exerciseHistory.test.ts (ring bound/order/dedupe), components/dashboard/DaySelector.test.tsx (AC-13 today auto-select Wed + Sunday rest variant), components/workout/SetTracker.test.tsx (quick-log flow + PR flag/celebration).

NEEDS VERIFICATION DURING IMPLEMENTATION (no real/emulated creds): offline SetLog persistence against live/emulated Firestore (the single-doc logSet + the waitForPendingWrites-gated completeSession batch + the C.9 parentOpen/sessionCompleted freeze rules), the Step-3 summaryApplied runTransaction idempotency, and the live PR celebration render (gsap/confetti). All are coded against the guarded SDK and short-circuit to firebase/not-configured under empty env; validate once creds exist.

FOLLOW-UP NOTES FOR LATER FEATURES: (1) ProgressionRecommendation currently passes a fixed recoveryScore=70/e1rmTrendFlat=false; wire real recovery (FEAT-005 recoveryStore) + e1RM trend from analytics when they land. (2) completeSession is called with personalRecords:[] from ActiveWorkout — PRs are flagged live on sets + queued for celebration, but persisting the PersonalRecord docs in the completion batch should pass buildPersonalRecords output (collect flagged sets) once the live-persist path is exercised against creds; the batch + deterministic ids already support it. (3) The weekly/monthly summary Step-3 transaction (analyticsService) and the custom syncQueue orchestration of the composite op are FEAT-004 (sync layer); markSummaryApplied + the waitForPendingWrites barrier are in place for it. (4) rpeMode/smartRestEnabled/autoStartRest/unit are read from profile.preferredUnit with sensible defaults in ActiveWorkout; wire the live UserSettings doc (rpeMode/smartRestEnabled/autoStartRest) when the settings read is hydrated into a store.
